item.title: Observation of Antichiral Hinge States in a Three-Dimensional Gyromagnetic Photonic Crystal
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 26 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77286-6

This work reports the observation of antichiral hinge states in a 3D gyromagnetic photonic crystal. Extending antichirality to higher-order topology, it reveals a topological semimetal with co-propagating transport along parallel hinges.

item.title: De-Occluding Broadband Metalens
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76606-0

The authors demonstrate a de-occluding metalens that separates spectral bands to suppress nearby obstructions while preserving broadband imaging. The approach improves image quality and machine vision performance for robust sensing and vision.

item.title: Author Correction: Edge-Guided Inverse Design of Digital Metamaterial-Based Mode Multiplexers for High-Capacity Multi-Dimensional Optical Interconnect
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 10 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76545-w

Author Correction: Edge-guided inverse design of digital metamaterial-based mode multiplexers for high-capacity multi-dimensional optical interconnect

item.title: Programmable Radio-Frequency Calculations in Electromagnetic-Wave Domain
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76229-5

The authors demonstrate a programmable metasurface that directly performs Fourier transforms and convolutions on radio-frequency waves, enabling reconfigurable real time signal processing while reducing reliance on conventional digital hardware.

item.title: Biomimetic Diffusion Metamaterials Enabled by Physical-Geometric Duality
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76322-9

Leaf-inspired, this work links physical equivalence and geometric transformation into a physical-geometric duality, reconciling structural functionality and manufacturability to directly fabricate complex, omnidirectional diffusion metamaterials.

item.title: Wave Morphing Towards the Flat-Top Envelope in Photonics Systems Driven by Artificial Gauge Fields
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 29 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76042-0

Whether a confined wave system can support a uniform, nonzero eigenstate has long been a counterintuitive question. Here, authors answer it by using artificial gauge fields from boundary phases to morph conventional modes into a flat-top state, and demonstrate the morphing via single-mode lasing in photonic crystals.

item.title: An Ingestible Origami-Inspired Metamaterial for Prolonged Oral Delivery of Therapeutics
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76028-y

Poor adherence to oral drug regimen adversely affects treatments. Here, the authors developed an origami-inspired, oral drug delivery dosage form capable of prolonged residence in the gastric cavity.

item.title: Interactively Addressable Organic Metadevices
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 16 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75757-4

An interactively addressable organic metadevice enables independent electrical control of metasurface pixels to generate reconfigurable holographic projections, providing a platform for programmable and user-interactive photonic systems.

item.title: Inhibited Radiative Decay Enhances Single-Photon Emitters
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 16 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75489-5

Spin–photon interfaces for quantum networks often rely on resonator enhanced emission, limiting scalability and requiring precise tuning. Here, the authors demonstrate an alternative approach that avoids these limitations by suppressing unwanted radiative decay channels of erbium dopants using silicon photonic crystal waveguides.

item.title: Chip-Integrated Metasurface-Enabled Single-Photon Skyrmion Sources
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 11 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75516-5

On-chip generation of single-photon skyrmions is challenging due to the nanoscale confinement of quantum emitters. Here the authors demonstrate a metasurface-integrated quantum emitter platform enabling room-temperature on-chip generation of single-photon skyrmions without requiring magnetic fields.

item.title: Two-Dimensional Pixel-Level Addressable Mid-Infrared Metasurface Spatial Light Modulator
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 07 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75346-5

A mid-infrared amplitude metasurface spatial light modulator using phase change materials is demonstrated in a scalable crossbar architecture on a silicon foundry platform, allowing for high density, tunable pixel metasurfaces.

item.title: STARE: A Semiconductor-Integrated Transmit-Array Architecture for 6G Beamforming
item.description:
Nature Communications, Published online: 01 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74911-2

This study presents STARE, a semiconductor integrated reconfigurable intelligent surface that embeds diodes in silicon to steer wireless beams, offering a scalable route for 6G communication systems.
